retrievalProfile.description: A centered glamour portrait featuring soft-focus lighting, voluminous hair, and high-contrast pink serif typography that overlaps the subject.
triggerTerms: soft focus glamour portrait with pink serif text
zebra print fashion photography with yellow gradient background

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a close-up portrait of a woman with large, textured hair and vibrant pink makeup, set against a warm yellow-to-white gradient. The layout is defined by oversized, high-contrast serif lettering in bright pink that frames the top and bottom of the image, often overlapping the subject's hair and clothing.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's voluminous hair creates a dark textural mass against a light gradient background
Bright pink typography color-matches the subject's lipstick and blush
Zebra print clothing provides a high-contrast graphic pattern at the bottom
Oversized header text creates a frame that the subject sits within
coreInvariants: Pink as the primary accent color for both text and makeup

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered bust-up portrait, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large pink header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large header text down to the subject's face, following the hair's volume to the patterned clothing and bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and the area around the neck, filled with a soft yellow gradient.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and pale yellow (background and clothing highlights)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark brown (hair and zebra stripes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the pink accents against a desaturated, warm-toned portrait.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm yellows, pinks, and monochrome

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Oversized initial letters that may bleed off the canvas
Tight letter spacing causing characters to touch

composition.overlap: behind and in front of hair

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scales of the same high-contrast serif family.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule lines separating text blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the extreme contrast and 80s editorial feel.
Provides the elegant, thin hairline serifs required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus glamour portrait of a woman with voluminous 80s hair and zebra print clothing against a warm yellow-white gradient background. Ensure vibrant pink makeup.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, high-contrast pink Didone-style uppercase text at the top and bottom, allowing the top text to partially overlap the hair.

verificationChecks: Is the pink color consistent between makeup and text?
Does the top text have extreme stroke contrast?
Is the background a soft yellow gradient?
Is the hair voluminous and textured?

adjustableVariables: Pattern density of the zebra print
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Exact wording of the album title and artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure soft-focus lighting doesn't blur the text
Confirm zebra print is clearly defined
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus portrait + Zebra print + Yellow gradient + Pink Didone typography
